source_scope.design_review_scope: This single role only; no set diversity evaluation, no print validation and no external reference comparison.

views.observations: Cream title occupies upper left. One large illuminated white blossom at middle-right, a smaller white blossom below-left, dark overlapping foliage and buds continue across right and bottom crop.
Both title lines are readable without enlargement at this screen size. The large right flower and two-line title form the principal visual masses.
All six syllables recognized at the viewed thumbnail; bright main flower competes with large cream title for first attention, while the smaller flower remains distinct.

copy_check.notes: Manually inspected in all three actual views. No missing or repeated syllable observed.

mandatory_conditions.evidence: Manually transcribed upper-left two-line title in all three views. No other text-like printed marks seen.
One fresh imagegen call returned one full-bleed image; no panel, frame or mockup visible.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Limited light, photographic observed garden, title and crop organize a continuous space
mandatory_conditions.evidence: Warm restricted light hits the right blossom and selected leaf edges, with a darker lower blossom and blurred background foliage. Title sits in upper-left darkness with plant mass running down right and into bottom crop. The strength of the title/crop relationship remains a design uncertainty.
mandatory_conditions.location: main blossom x490–990 y390–830; second blossom x140–500 y830–1230; title x60–702 y130–523

retained_defects_uncertainties.observation: The title remains concentrated in the dark upper-left cavity. Its relationship to the garden crop is primarily adjacency and shared negative space; no visibly specific title alignment controls a stem or petal boundary.
retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: The requested continuous title/image space may read as conventional title-over-photograph placement; independent reviewer should assess this relationship.

retained_defects_uncertainties.observation: The pale main flower has very sharp wrinkled petal detail and warm raking light, while much surrounding foliage is soft or glossy.
retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: I can observe internally plausible depth but cannot establish botanical specimen accuracy or exclude synthesis artifacts from appearance alone.

retained_defects_uncertainties.observation: A broad dark interval separates the title from the smaller lower blossom, with soft background foliage rather than a clear physical path.
retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: The spatial connection may be weaker than the intended close observation concept at thumbnail scale.
